sources.snippet: Multimodal This model supports image and audio input. Alongside the quants, this repo includes the multimodal projector files mmproj-TheDrummer_Spectre-37B-v1-bf16.gguf and mmproj-TheDrummer_Spectre-37B-v1-f16.gguf, which pair with any quant above.
